department: Civil Supplies and Consumer Protection Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
what_it_is: You can apply for a new ration card through e-Sevai. Printing of the smart card is a separate e-Sevai service.
how_to_apply: Apply through e-Sevai for 'Application for New Ration Card'. Fill in the applicant's details and address in Tamil and English. Choose your district, taluk and village. Add each family member. Add gas connection details if you have one. Pay the fee and print the receipt.
where_to_apply: Online through the e-Sevai portal (it opens the Public Distribution System portal), or at an e-Sevai centre.
fee: Rs 60 service charge at e-Sevai for a new card. The department charge is Rs 0. Printing of the smart card is also Rs 60.
